### M1-E05 · Fares in cents

> **GENERATED · written for this system (reinforces a concept from the source)**  
> Source: [lecture2 L540-571](../../sources/lecture2.txt) *“it can get very wonky if I really need that kind of precision”*

| Topic / concepts | Difficulty | Skills | Dataset | Task type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1.5 | ★★ | REAL vs INTEGER, CAST, ROUND, SUM | `charlie` | write a query |

The `log.fare` column stores dollars as REAL values (0.10, 0.05, ...). Floating-point values aren't exact.
Return a single number: the **total of all fares in whole cents**, as an integer.

<details><summary>Expected output (try first!)</summary>

| SUM(CAST(ROUND("fare" * 100) AS INTEGER)) |
|---|
| 50 |

</details>

From a blank database, write the complete final schema of Lecture 2: `cards`, `stations`, `swipes`.
Use the same constraints the lecture ends with: unique, required station names; a required line;
the swipe-type list; the timestamp default; a non-zero amount; and all keys.
(This combines M1-E07 and M1-E08, so try it without looking.)
